activation: Only explicit operator launch with --execute-frozen-test creates a separate test-unlock record before sample access.

analysis.criterion_type: Predeclared descriptive consistency criterion; not a significance test or replication of test MA(5).
analysis.bootstrap_scheme: Resample paired seeds and one shared group-index list across every operator and both budgets. Keep operator set fixed.

selected_endpoint: Test score of the single checkpoint selected by the right end of the maximal validation-MA(5) window; no selection using test scores.
